plain: Acting against something with equal force.

webster.text: Opposing with equal strength or value; balancing; obviating an effect.

example.quote: Hence the impatient and rigorous use made of that treaty in her "countervailing act," which cuts the throat of the American navigation, and transfuses the vital blood of it into her own.
example.cite: James Madison, Foreign Influence, Aurora General Advertiser, Jan. 23, 1799
